newsitem.title: CHINA: China Star to place 665.25 mln warrants.
newsitem.headline: China Star to place 665.25 mln warrants.

text.p: China Star Entertainment Ltd said on Friday it had agreed to place through underwriters 665.25 million 1997-1998 warrants which entitle warrant holders to subscribe up to HK$192.92 million in new company shares.

The film producer and distributor said the warrants, which would be issued at HK$0.04 each, would entitle holders the right to subscribe for one new company share at HK$0.29 each, subject to adjustment, between August 26, 1997 and November 26, 1998.
The company said it would be required to issue 665.25 million new shares, or 16.67 percent of the enlarged share capital, upon full exercise of the warrants.
It said it would use the net proceed of HK$24.1 million raised from the warrant issue to purchase rights to distribute television drama series and costume films produced by Japanese producers.
The proceeds will also be used for the establishment of video products retail outlets in China and for general working capital, it said.
China Star shares ended at HK$0.30 each on Thursday.
